proposedManifest.name: Avengers: Armageddon
proposedManifest.description: Chip Zdarsky's 2026 Avengers event in Comic Book Herald's reading order. The prologue gathers The Will of Doom, Captain America, Ultimate Impact: Reborn, Wolverine: Weapons of Armageddon and the Comics Giveaway Day issue, then the five-issue main series runs alongside its Captain America chapters and ends with Avengers (2026) #1. One comic in Comic Book Herald's order, Immortal Soldiers #1, isn't available digitally yet, so it isn't in this list for now.
